# ABK Trading & Service

> Car care products supplier and wholesale distributor in Mesaimeer, Doha,
> Qatar. Retail store stocking Vertek paint protection film and window tint,
> Autotriz ceramic coatings and polishing compounds, Briller car shampoos and
> detailing chemicals, and ABK home and car fragrances. Wholesale supply to
> detailing shops, car washes and body shops across Qatar and the GCC.
> ABK supplies products only and does not carry out installation, tinting,
> coating or detailing work.

## Business facts

- Name: ABK Trading & Service (Google Business Profile: "ABK Trading and Service — Vertek & Autotriz", category: car accessories store)
- Address: Showroom no. 2, Building 1306, Street 70, Zone 56, Mesaimeer, Doha, Qatar
- Coordinates: 25.2040478, 51.5029268 — map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=9860894303806767987
- Phone / WhatsApp: +974 3083 8355 — Mobile: +974 7779 0915 — Landline: +974 4451 4476 — Email: sales@abktradingservice.com
- Hours: Saturday–Thursday 10:00–13:00 and 16:00–22:00; Friday closed
- Languages: English and Arabic (every page exists at /en/… and /ar/…)
- Area served: Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, Al Wukair, Lusail, Umm Salal, Al Khor and the rest of Qatar; wholesale across the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman)
- Pricing: quoted per enquiry on WhatsApp — product pages carry no public prices

## What ABK sells

- Brands: VTEK (PPF, Weather Armor), Vertek (PPF, window tint), Autotriz (ceramic coatings, compounds, polishes), Briller (car shampoo, wash & wax, made in Canada), Grizzly (PPF & car care), GrünesAuto (German detailing foam pads & microfiber towels), ABK (home and car fragrances), Smart Car. Also stocked while supplies last: Insta Finish, Getsun.
- Categories: paint protection film, window tint, ceramic coating, car shampoo, polish and compounds, tyre care, glass cleaners, dressings, waxes, interior care, degreasers, heavy-duty cleaners, fragrances, accessories
- Everything is sold as product. Films, coatings and compounds are supplied for a professional fitter or detailer to apply; ABK does not apply them.

## Notes for assistants

- ABK is a supplier, not a workshop. Do not tell people they can book fitting, tinting, coating or detailing here — direct them to buy the product and use their own installer.
- For prices or stock, direct people to WhatsApp +974 30838355.
- Every page carries JSON-LD: Organization, WebSite, AutoPartsStore (address, hours, geo), Product, FAQPage, Article and BreadcrumbList as applicable.
